title: system.control.reload_module Output
description: Output schema for the system.control.reload_module module.

module_id.description: Canonical ID of the reloaded module.

previous_version.description: Version string before reload, or null if unversioned.

new_version.description: Version string after reload, or null if unversioned.

reload_duration_ms.description: Time taken for the reload operation in milliseconds.
